title: CropsCatalogSchema
description: JSON Schema specification for agronomic, physiological, economic, and resilience attributes of crops in El Bajío catalog.

cycle.description: Growing cycle: Primavera-Verano / Summer (PV), Otoño-Invierno / Winter (OI), or Annual/Perennial

es_leguminosa.description: True if crop is a nitrogen-fixing legume

gdd_requerido.description: Growing Degree Days required to reach physiological maturity

t_base_c.description: Base temperature in °C below which growth stops

temp_min_tolerable_c.description: Minimum tolerable temperature in °C before frost damage

temp_max_tolerable_c.description: Maximum tolerable temperature in °C before heat stress damage

duracion_ciclo_dias.description: Total cycle duration in days from planting to harvest

etapas_crecimiento.description: Key growth stages (e.g. Germinación, Crecimiento vegetativo, Floración, Maduración)

demanda_hidrica_mm.description: Total water requirement per cycle in mm

fraccion_agotamiento_p.description: Soil water depletion fraction p (FAO-56 Table 22)

rendimiento_ton_ha.description: Expected yield in metric tons per hectare

precio_venta_usd_ton.description: Commercial sale price in USD per ton

costo_semilla_usd_ha.description: Seed investment cost in USD per hectare

costo_fertilizante_usd_ha.description: Fertilizer cost in USD per hectare

costo_riego_usd_ha.description: Irrigation water cost in USD per hectare

fijacion_nitrogeno_kg_ha.description: Atmospheric nitrogen biologically fixed in kg/ha

profit_usd_ha.description: Estimated net profit in USD/ha (normalized global metric)

agroecological_zones.description: Compatible global agroecological zones (e.g. temperate, subtropical, semiarid, tropical, mediterranean)

root_depth_max_m.description: Maximum rooting depth in meters (FAO-56 Table 22)

verified.description: Flag indicating if values have been verified against local SIAP/INIFAP records
